options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:

options.doc_fr:

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:

options.name: filler game
options.doc:
limits the amount of locations that can have a progression item in them
none: no limit on what locations can have useful/progression
shop: excludes shop locations from having useful/progression items
full: no location in this slot will have useful/progression items in it(NOTE may cause generation to fail depending on other game slots)

options.name: force goal
options.doc:
true will set the goal to be getting trophy's
false will set the goal to max out every girls style/talent

options.name: min trophy
options.doc: sets the minimum trophy that will complete goal

options.name: trophy logic girls
options.doc:
if set TRUE will put the logic of obtaining trophies behind having percentage of girls unlocked can be combined with slot_trophy_logic and account_trophy_logic
bronze: always in logic
silver: requires 1/4 available girls (rounded down) to be in logic
gold: requires 1/2 available girls (rounded down) to be in logic
platinum: requires 3/4 available girls (rounded down) to be in logic
diamond: requires all available girls to be in logic

options.name: trophy logic slots
options.doc:
if set TRUE will put the logic of obtaining trophies behind having girl slots unlocked can be combined with girl_trophy_logic and account_trophy_logic
bronze: always in logic
silver: requires at least 2 slots available to be in logic
gold: requires at least 4 slots available to be in logic
platinum: requires at least 6 slots available to be in logic
diamond: requires all 8 slots to be in logic

options.name: trophy logic accounting
options.doc:
if set TRUE will put the logic of obtaining trophies behind having accounting upgrades unlocked can be combined with girl_trophy_logic and slot_trophy_logic
bronze: always in logic
silver: requires at least 3 accounting upgrades available to be in logic
gold: requires at least 7 accounting upgrades available to be in logic
platinum: requires at least 11 accounting upgrades available to be in logic
diamond: requires all 15 accounting upgrades to be in logic

options.name: trophy outside logic
options.doc: forces trophy to only be obtainable if accessible in logic

options.name: force goal
options.doc: forces the goal to be achieved in 21 ingame days from starting a new save (NOTE: this still means you need to wait till the trophy check on the 22 day)
